'''Latara''' was a prankster spirit in [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] mythology, known for stealing sweets from inattentive [[Wokling/Legends|Ewok children]]. "Latara" was a popular name for female Ewoks,<ref name="GCG" /> such as [[Latara/Legends|the young Ewok]] of [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|Bright Tree Village]].<ref name="Ewoks">[[Ewoks (television series)|''Ewoks'']]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Bozzie was mentioned in the ''[[Galactic Campaign Guide]]'', a [[2003]] supplement for [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' that was written by [[Peter M. Schweighofer|Peter Schweighofer]] and [[J.D. Wiker]].<ref name="GCG" />
